Name: UI Info Suite 2 Redux
Author: Ekysoh
Description:
Here's the start of my rework for UI info Suite 2. The aim is to have this compatible with mods that neither the UI Info Suite 2 Android and OG UI Info Suite 2 currently support. Original code is based off Cdaragorn's and Annosz's work. All I did was port it over to Android + added new initial features. This is only currently being tested for mobile. As such, [b]it will not work for PC (YET).[/b][list=1]

﻿[/list]Below are the new features so far:[list]
[*]Experience Bars can be placed in either corner of the screen and can be adjusted with horizontal and vertical padding
[*]Experience bars can be drawn horizontally or vertically
[*]Icons can be placed in either corner of the screen and can be adjusted with horizontal and vertical padding
[*]Icons can be can be drawn horizontally or vertically
[*]Tooltips are now shown anchored appropriately to the finger and are not shown when using the virtual joypad
[*]Item ranges (scarecrow, sprinklers, etc) are now shown in the tile in front of the player when holding the item. They can also be shown when tapping over an item that has a range associated with it. Hovering is not shown when using the virtual joypad.
[/list]+ bug fixes that I found while testing.

Downloads.Description:
- Added compatibility with Quick Save mod
- Buffs can be placed anywhere on screen
- Notifications can be placed anywhere on screen
- Added sections in menu for clarity
- Added caching to to improve runtime speeds
- Added check for tooltips on virtualpad
